items.text: Zombie Graveyard

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Wow! So this is what a graveyard looks like at night. It's got that proper graveyard-y feel down pat, that's for sure!

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: You scared?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: No, mate!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Is that true then ... there would be, y'know, zombies about?

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Of course, they're right under your feet! Keep it down, though. They'll all be resting at this time of year.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Oh, sorry 'bout that. Shhh.
Together, the children navigate the silent field of gravestones, venturing deeper into the graveyard.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Strange, I haven't spotted any of those lights, but they should be close by, right?

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Didn't the Administrator say fairies like to hide names inside things people hold dear?

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Erm, to tell the truth, I'm not entirely sure what that means, but surely there's someone around here who might know.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Speak of the devil! There's someone right over there!

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: *sigh*
Resting against a gravestone, a large, eerie silhouette heaves a sorrowful sigh.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: 'Scuse me, mister ... but ... Oh, he don't look like the chummiest of chaps now, does he?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: He ain't a zombie that's woken up too early, is he?

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: No, that's the Tomb Watcher. He isn't a zombie, just a bit odd.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Though he's supposed to be already making his rounds at this time of night. What's keeping him?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: But maybe he knows something about me name. No harm in asking, I s'pose.
Flutterpage takes a deep breath, steadying her nerves as she prepares to approach the towering figure.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: 'Scuse me, sir, could I—

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: S-S-S-Sorry, guv! I'll be off in a tick. Oh!
Flutterpage gawks at the tomb watcher as he topples down from the gravestone, seeming more frightened than she is at their meeting.

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: Wait, who are you?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Sorry if I gave you a fright. We're looking for somethin' and was wonderin' if you might be able to lend a hand?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: This thing I'm lookin' for, it looks a bit like a firefly, but it's actually, uh, my name.
As the words leave her mouth, Flutterpage realizes just how absurd this all sounds.
As expected, the hulking figure pulls himself upright, glaring at Flutterpage with suspicion as his menacing face edges closer.

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: Harken, little one! I don't know what this is all about, but if someone put you up to takin' the mickey outta me ...

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: I'll ...

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Ahhh. Y-You'll what?

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: I'll ... I'll ...

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: If you say so, I'll nothin' ... I'm just a big ol' nobody, ain't I?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Uhm.
The tomb watcher slumps back against the gravestone with a long sigh, utterly defeated.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Why would ya say somethin' like that?

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: Word is the Bananach's back, so we set up a patrol. Everyone else's out making their rounds as we speak.

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: But I can't help thinkin', what if I actually come face-to-face with the Bananach?

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: I was shakin' in me boots, just thinkin' about it! That's why I ... I snuck out of my part of the graveyard.

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: I know I can't keep hidin', can I? I've gotta get back, yeah, back to me post!
The tomb watcher wobbles to his feet, every step a battle against his trembling knees.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: No. I don't get it. You're heading off back there? Didn't you just say you were scared?

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: I am scared! But, but that don't mean I can just scarper. I gotta face it. I ain't no coward!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Hmm?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Why not? Why can't you just leave?

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: What do ya mean?
Flutterpage's tone is genuinely confused, prompting the tomb watcher and Lamplighter to exchange surprised glances.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: I'm thinking ... If you're that scared, why don't you get someone to cover for you?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: But I dunno what else you lot get up to 'round here. I reckon there must be plenty to do besides wanderin' about.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: What about sortin' out meals for everyone, fixin' their clothes, or even wakin' them up in the mornin'? That way, you'd still be pullin' your weight, wouldn't ya?

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: I ... I can't do that! That's the kinda thing only a coward would do! They'd be out there patrollin', while I'd be stuck doing some fiddly little busywork? That ... well, that ...

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: What's it matter, though?

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: That'd make me look strange! My friends will make fun of me.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: I don't think so, no.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: I think ... they really ain't much good as friends at all. Real mates wouldn't treat ya like that.
The tomb watcher falls into silence for a while, emitting a mixture of confusion and helplessness from behind his mask.
Until at last, his shoulders slump gently.

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: Maybe ... Maybe you're right.

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: I shouldn't care what those lot think of me, should I?
He lingers there, unmoving, head drooped on the spot, and then, with unexpected resolve, takes a deep breath.

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: Dash it all! I ain't goin'! Coward or not, who cares?

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: Ta for that, love! Haha! I don't think I've ever felt this good in me life!

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: Now, I don't 'ave a clue about this thingamajig you're lookin' for, but ...

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: You're welcome to 'ave this, if you want it.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: A present? Oh, that's brilliant—Hold on, you made this yourself, didn't ya?
She eyes the necklace made with feathers and pebbles, tied with a common bowknot.

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: Yeah, I did. Truth is, I've always been fond of makin' stuff like this, but everyone reckons it's for softies.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Don't be daft! It's well impressive, it is!
Flutterpage takes the necklace and holds it against her neck, tilting her head as she visualizes wearing it.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Watcha think? Reckon it suits me?

items.speaker: Tomb Watcher
items.text: Smashin'! Proper smashing love! Cheers for everythin', and I mean it.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Why? What're you thankin' me for? You're the one who gave me a gift. It's me who should be thankin' you.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Thank you!
With a small smile that sneaks through from behind his monstrous mask, the tomb watcher departs with a wave as he vanishes into the shadows.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: You know, I reckon not many people would've thought like you just did.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: What're you gettin' at?

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Most people would try to push him into being brave, don't you think?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Why? Why should he have to be brave if that ain't what he wants to be?

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Because ... well, never mind.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: You know, I've got to say I've taken a liking to you.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Thank you. Cheers, mate!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: But it feels like I'm forgettin' somethin' important.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: That's right, you certainly have.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Oh yeah, my name! That's why we came here!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: But where could it be? Eh?
The tomb watcher's necklace begins to warm in her hand, and the fireflies fly out to dance around Flutterpage once more.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: This is ...

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Another bit of your name! Did they come out from that necklace?

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Of course! Ms. Administrator did warn us that fairies liked hiding names in things people cherish. Looks like she was right once again!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Wow! Doesn't matter if it ain't my first time seeing this, it's still bleeding amazin'.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Good news, anyway! I've snagged me my second letter, haven't I?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: So, it leaves us with five more to find. Urgh.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Why'd there have to be so many letters in my name? If it was somethin' simple like "Me," we'd be done an' dusted by now!

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Haha! Now that's a thought! Still, I've got a feeling we'd somehow find ourselves in a twist anyway.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Let's pick up the pace. Remember, we've only got until dawn to put your name back together.
